SMH Overlay — Does It Earn Its Place?

Same MGK/MGV base regime throughout, completely unaffected by this layer. An independent trigger — the 5-day rate of change of the SMH/MGV raw-close ratio — adds a 30% SMH sleeve on top of whichever asset the base regime already holds. Entry at ROC5 ≥+2.0%, exit at ROC5 ≤-2.0%, both requiring 5 consecutive trading days to confirm. Validated across 5yr / 10yr / Jan-2016 / Jan-2021 / 2021-2023-stress windows: beats the base regime alone on both CAGR and Sharpe in every one. Six other sectors (XLI, IYR, XLV, XLU, XLY, XLE) and two alternative trigger ratios (SMH/VOO, SMH/XLE) were tested and did not clear this bar.
